description: Read a PDF's page count, encryption flag, metadata, page sizes in millimetres, text-layer presence and bookmark count. Cost: 1 credit per call. File input (file): base64 string, data: URI or {"url": "https://..."}. Output: JSON. {page_count, encrypted, password_required, metadata: {title, author, subject, creator, producer}, page_sizes_mm: [{n, width, height}] (first 50 pages), has_text, outline_count}

file.description: The PDF: base64 string (or data: URI) or {"url": "https://..."}. Up to 10 MB.

name: pdf_info
title: PDF info reader
